description: The network-wide spread of how long answers waited from their origin epoch to the close that settled them (age in epochs = settle close minus origin epoch), from the public close records, reusing the Settlement view's origin bucketing. rows are age bands (0, 1, 2-3, 4-7, 8-15, 16+) with answers (juried answers) and share; expired_no_jury (settled past the pending TTL with no jury) and unknown (origin not on record) are reported apart, never bucketed by age; median_age_epochs, settled, juried, closes and first_close too. A distribution only: no address, no verdict, never per grader. A grading verdict is never read. CSV at /api/v1/governance/settle-age.csv. Use it to see how long answers sat before grading settled them.

dir.description: desc (default: the key's natural order) or asc (reversed)

segment.description: chain segment: omit for the current one; 1 reads segment 1 (archived at the 2026-10-24 genesis cut), whose epoch numbers repeat in the current segment

sort.description: band (default: by age), answers or share

name: get_settle_age
title: Settle age
